notes.subject: igũrũ/thĩ — thĩ/igũrũ
notes.rationale: Hebrew reverses the order: heavens-earth at creation, earth-heavens at making; the chiastic inversion is kept but the sound-play is lost in Gĩkũyũ.

notes.subject: mũthenya ũmwe
notes.rationale: ביום 'in the day' — singular though creation spans days; some read it as 'when', others literally.

notes.subject: mĩtaratara
notes.rationale: תולדות literally 'generations/descents' — rendered as 'account/origins' as most versions do.

notes.subject: wa mũthenya
notes.rationale: עשות is an infinitive construct bound to יהוה אלהים; Gĩkũyũ needs a finite verb with subject prefix.

translation: Ici nĩ mĩtaratara ya igũrũ na ya thĩ rĩrĩa cionbirwo, mũthenya ũrĩa Yahwe Erohimu akĩthondeka thĩ na igũrũ.
